title: Harness resource-watchdog: high-RAM emergency mode
desc: When system RAM crosses the gate threshold the watchdog blocks heavy commands and allows only recovery/read-only/skill ops, to keep the machine from OOM while protecting the AI work set.
steps: TRIGGER: fires when measured RAM percent exceeds the gate (around 85-88 percent) and the command is not read-only/skill/git. Emergency, recovery-ops-only mode.

FIX: free RAM first -- close Chrome tabs, run wkappbot taskkill /IM wkappbot-core.exe --dry-run to spot zombies, or wkdoctor -EmergencyKill (score-based, spares the AI family). Read-only tools and wkappbot skill ops stay allowed. Delegate heavy work via Agent.cmd --model haiku.
WHY: above the gate the box risks OOM/paging death; the watchdog buys time without killing active AI sessions. See: wkdoctor-system-physician, wkappbot-taskkill-usage.
author: claude
